purpose: Rank3 concrete course projects; document hypothesis,framework,controlled experiments,risks and static findings.
preferred_project: A:Top-score versus scaffold-balanced replay under fixed oracle/training budgets

sources.title: ACEGEN: Reinforcement Learning of Generative Chemical Agents for Drug Discovery (2024)
sources.supports: Common framework and replay/prior/highlikelihood-penalty ablations motivate controlled comparisons.
sources.limits: Not proof proposed buffer will outperform; no local reproduction.

sources.title: ACEGEN official README, configuration and REINVENT training source
evidence_location: run_reinvent:replay buffer, loss combination, penalty, update
sources.supports: Script has replay and unconditional added high-likelihood penalty; stored historical reward; fixed-source changes needed for controlled loss.
sources.limits: Dynamic main, no commit pinned or execution; penalty effect not empirically reverified.

sources.title: ACEGEN official DPO implementation
sources.supports: Fresh scored samples each loop; neg_mask defined but negative likelihood uses pos_mask in inspected main source.
sources.limits: Static mask risk, not runtime diagnosis; fix/test required before reuse. No upstream contact performed.

sources.title: Diverse Hits in De Novo Molecule Design: Diversity-Based Comparison of Goal-Directed Generators (2024-07-19 online)
sources.supports: Diverse-hit evaluation, property filters, RF scores, sample/time constraints; directly relevant competing evaluation.
sources.limits: Predicted hits not measured activity; source settings are protocol-specific.

sources.title: diverse-hits official code
sources.supports: Scoring package tracks unique molecule queries, time limits and diversity; optimizer integration possible.
sources.limits: No install/run; full dependency setup deliberately not invoked.

sources.title: Sample-efficient generative molecular design using memory manipulation (2026-03-17)
sources.supports: Saturn/replay/augmentation efficiency-diversity relationship; closely competing prior work.
sources.limits: No innovation claim for memory/diversity combination; computed proxy evidence.

sources.title: Sample Efficiency Matters: A Benchmark for Practical Molecular Optimization (NeurIPS2022)
sources.supports: Oracle-budget comparisons and top-k AUC; strong baseline evaluation.
sources.limits: Proposed diverse-hits protocol is not automatically same as PMO.

sources.title: REINVENT4 (2024) and official scoring/RL documentation
sources.supports: Mature reward composition and diversity mechanisms; these components are existing methods.
sources.limits: Not built-in proof of primal-dual CMDP or scaffold-balanced replay effect.

sources.title: DrugEx v2 (2021)
sources.supports: Existing multiple-objective scalar/Pareto work contextualizes candidateB.
sources.limits: CandidateB primal-dual formulation is this project proposal, not attributed to DrugEx.

sources.title: Preference Optimization for Molecular Language Models (2023-10-18 preprint)
sources.supports: MolecularDPO already applied to filters/predicted bioactivity; fixed-reference preference training precedent.
sources.limits: No novelty claim for SMILESDPO; oracle labels not human feedback.

sources.title: Augmented Memory official repository maintenance note
sources.supports: Official repo says no longer updated and points to Saturn.
